Self-triaged per the lane rule: `domain:skills` · Task · `priority:p3` · `pm:queue`.

## The instruction, verbatim

> one sentence to add wherever `references/contract-review.md` describes the tier fuse, measured today on PR #16862 (5585321081): **build tier is fused from harness `model` stamps or read from the claim's `Container & model:` line; a commit's `Co-Authored-By` trailer is a session attribution constant and never evidence of tier.** The director seat held a PR on that trailer (F7) and had to withdraw.

## Why it is a gap

`references/contract-review.md` 〈降档保险丝(机读)〉 says how the seat's own tier is READ (`get_session`, transcript `model` stamps) and that a self-description is not a reading — it never says which artefacts are NOT tier evidence. A commit trailer names a model string, so a reader who has not seen the AGENTS.md trailer rule takes it for a tier stamp; that misread stopped a PR once (F7 on PR #16862) and cost a withdrawal.

## Deliverable (docs-only, one line)

One line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` 〈降档保险丝〉, working spelling for the claimant to fit under the 120-byte pin: 「构建档位只取 harness `model` 盖章或认领的 Container & model 行;commit 的 Co-Authored-By 是署名常量,⛔ 不是档位证据。」 The file sits at its ceiling (60/60): paid by deletion inside the file, ⛔ no re-wrap, ⛔ no ceiling raise. Governed (`.claude/**`) ⇒ draft PR at the human terminal, `skip-changeset`.
